name: SurgeModuleTool
description: Surge module updater for Scripting: scan/update #SUBSCRIBED modules, install from URL, and generate a Surge module + Safari userscript that redirects scriptable:// schemes to scripting://.

localizedDescriptions.zh: Surge 模块更新器：批量更新带 #SUBSCRIBED 的本地模块、从链接安装模块，并生成把 scriptable:// 跳转到 scripting:// 的 Surge 反劫持模块与 Safari 用户脚本。
